role: A no-lookahead half-month oil strategy with a continuous turnover preference, weekly execution windows, capacity-constrained named-contract positions, and gross-turnover mark-to-market reports.
invariants: strategy decisions read only the current visible futures payload, current published forecast, current account state, and explicit turnover preference
configured institution capability scores are research metadata and never enter signal or position sizing formulas
turnover intensity changes target tracking, signal deadband, minimum tradable edge, and gross execution budget but never changes leverage or market limits
hidden future bars and future market payloads are unavailable to the decision function
positions exist only in named OIL-YYMM contracts and never in the continuous main index
mandatory risk reduction has priority and may use the full published per-turn trade limit
net adjustment and flat round trips share one published gross execution capacity
weekly round trips are planned from the published forecast and are filled only against weeks first realized after the decision cutoff
weekly execution weights are frozen from recently visible volume and never use future weekly volume
buy lots minus sell lots equals net position change and buy lots plus sell lots equals gross turnover
aggregate execution prices use only newly realized weekly OHLC data and contain no fees or friction in v2
the strategy never changes futures prices, market volume, market open interest, the forecast, or global macro rows
